name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari Mäkinen is a seasoned HR professional with a passion for motorsport that started in his youth, watching rally legends tear through the Finnish forests. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, he spent several years in corporate environments, honing his skills in recruitment, employee relations, and talent development. However, his love for racing never faded, and he actively sought opportunities to combine his profession with his passion.

An opportunity arose when MP Motorsport Junior was looking for an HR Manager to help build and manage their growing team. Jari jumped at the chance, bringing his corporate expertise to the high-octane world of motorsport. He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive team environment, where every member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Jari’s calm demeanor and problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset to the team, especially during the intense pressures of race weekends.

What sets Jari apart is his ability to connect with people from all walks of life. He's a firm believer in open communication and transparency, fostering trust and collaboration within the team. He is also a strong advocate for continuous learning and development, ensuring that MP Motorsport Junior attracts and retains top talent.

physical.description: Jari is a stocky man of average height, with a warm smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of offering people licorice (salmiakki) during stressful situations.
Secretly keeps a detailed spreadsheet of employee coffee preferences.
